See the Highlights

View more on a 10.9" display

Capture ideas with S Pen 1

Pair easily with Galaxy accessories

Easy-to-carry. Style-ready

Galaxy Tab S10 Lite is a slim tablet that's only 6.6 mm thin and lightweight, making it easy to carry in your tote, backpack, or hand. This large screen tablet comes in three stylish colours — Grey, Silver, and Coralred — that looks as good as it feels. Whether you're commuting or relaxing at home, this lightweight tablet is designed to fit your lifestyle with effortless portability.2

Grey

Silver

Coralred

Vibrant as your vision. Expansive as your ideas

Galaxy Tab S10 Lite features a 10.9-inch large display with a 90 Hz refresh rate for smooth scrolling and responsive motion while you watch, read, or create. The screen also includes SGS-certified blue light reduction to help reduce eye strain during long viewing sessions. From streaming your favourite content to editing projects, this display keeps it vivid and clear.3

Power to do more. Space to keep what matters

Performance stays smooth while you stream, browse, or multitask thanks to up to 8 GB of memory. You get up to 256 GB of internal storage, expandable up to 2 TB with microSD card. This tablet with S pen support makes it easy to capture ideas and work efficiently, giving you the space and speed you need to create without interruptions and keep everything in one place.4

Scribble with S Pen. Math instantly solved

Struggling with a complex math formula? Just write it out with S Pen and Solve Math will help to calculate the answer for you. This tablet makes study sessions simpler by letting you tackle math problems quickly without switching apps or losing focus. Whether you're working on assignments or practicing equations, it helps you learn more and move forward.5

Write it your way with S Pen.

Handwriting Help lets you quickly tidy up messy handwritten notes to keep your work looking polished. You can straighten uneven lines, make spacing consistent, align letters, and correct letter shapes in an instant. Jot down ideas, take study notes, or sketch freely with S Pen — your handwriting feels effortless.6

One press. The key to AI

Tap the dedicated AI key to instantly access smart help when you need it. With just one press, you can launch your personal AI assistant to get quick answers, helpful suggestions, or real-time support while you stay productive. With AI at your fingertips, tasks feel simpler and faster on your Galaxy Tab S10 Lite.7

Quick edits with Object Eraser

Remove background distractions or unwanted objects in your photos with Object Eraser. Just trace around the area you want to remove using S Pen, and it disappears. You can create clean, professional images without extra editing apps or complicated steps. From photobombers to cluttered backgrounds, Object Eraser makes your pictures look distraction-free.8

Super Fast charging for your busy day

Stay unplugged longer with the 8,000 mAh battery tablet designed to handle work, study, and entertainment without interruptions. When it's time to recharge, Super Fast Charging powers up the battery in no time, so you don't have to wait around. This fast charging tablet is perfect for busy mornings, back-to-back plans, or long streaming sessions with reliable power that keeps up you.9

Compatible with Galaxy accessories you love

Galaxy Tab S10 Lite works seamlessly with a variety of tablet accessories, including Book Cover Keyboard, Book Cover Keyboard Slim, Smart Book Cover, and Anti-Reflecting Screen Protector. These compatible options can help you type more comfortably, enjoy hands-free viewing, and protect your screen with added clarity — so you can personalise your setup to fit your needs.10

Galaxy Spotlight apps. Create like a pro

Unlock more creativity on Galaxy Tab S10 Lite with pro-grade apps. Get inspired with Clip Studio Paint, Goodnotes, LumaFusion, Notion, Noteshelf 3, ArcSite, Sketchbook and Picsart.

Frequently Asked Questions

Galaxy Tab S10 Lite offers two memory options: 6 GB memory + 128 GB storage or 8 GB memory + 256 GB storage. Yes, if you need more space, you can easily expand the storage up to 2 TB with a microSD card (sold separately). This gives you plenty of room for apps, class notes, videos, and creative projects without worrying about running out of space.11

When you unbox your new Galaxy Tab S10 Lite, you’ll find an S Pen for precise note-taking and creative tasks, a quick start guide to get you set up, an ejection pin for the SIM/microSD tray, and a USB Type-C data cable for charging and connecting.12

Yes, Galaxy Tab S10 Lite supports both S Pen and compatible Book Cover Keyboards. An S Pen is included in the box and allows for precise writing, sketching, and note-taking.
Galaxy Tab S10 Lite is also compatible with Samsung Book Cover Keyboard and Book Cover Keyboard Slim that turn your Tab into a work-ready setup. For added versatility and protection, you can use Smart Book Cover which offers flexible viewing angles, and Anti-Reflecting Screen Protector which helps reduce glare.13

Yes, Galaxy Tab S10 Lite is a versatile tablet designed to handle work, study, and entertainment. It comes with an S Pen to take notes, sketch, or solve math problems easily. Its large 10.9-inch display offers a comfortable view for reading, attending online classes, or streaming content. It's lightweight and portable, measuring 254.3 × 165.8 × 6.6 mm and weighing around 524 g, making it easy to carry anywhere. With long battery life and smooth performance, it's a great choice for everyday tasks and relaxation.14

Galaxy Tab S10 Lite has an 8,000 mAh battery, so you can watch, browse, or work without frequent charging.15

Galaxy Tab S10 Lite is eligible for up to 7 generations of Android OS upgrades, along with 7 years of security updates from the date of global launch. This long-term software support helps keep your tablet secure, up to date, and compatible with the latest features over time.16

Yes, you can quickly and easily transfer your iOS data to Galaxy Tab S10 Lite using Smart Switch.
Smart Switch is a tool that simplifies transferring data from one device to another by allowing you to seamlessly move contacts, photos, videos, notes, calendar events and more. You can connect your new Galaxy Tab S10 Lite to your old device using a cable or wirelessly using the Smart Switch app.17

Originally posted on Samsung UK
Response from Samsung:
2025-10-14

CX

It's brilliant to know that you're enjoying your gorgeous new Galaxy Tab S10 Lite! We're glad to hear that you found it easy to get used to with its user-friendly interface, although we're saddened to hear that it isn't compatible with your printer. It's compatible with most modern printers, although compatibility does depend on the printer's connectivity options and whether the necessary software or app is available from the printer manufacturer. There are a few different ways to turn your Tab S10 Lite off. You can press and hold the Side button and the Volume down button simultaneously until the power menu appears on the display, then tap Power off and confirm. Alternatively, you can swipe down from the top of the screen to access the Quick settings panel and tap the power icon, which will be located right at the top, next to the Settings cog. With some device settings, you may need to swipe down twice to see this, or use two fingers to swipe down. As you know, you can also ask Bixby or Gemini to turn the power off for you. Bear in mind that you can put your tablet to sleep by tapping the Side key, and this consumes very little battery in sleep mode. A bonus of putting it into sleep mode is that your tablet wakes up in a second or two, letting you resume exactly where you left off. It's great to hear that you're happy with the storage size, and with expandable storage up to a humongous 2 TB, you know you will never run out of space! Many thanks for taking the time to share your review! ^EW at Samsung Support
